description: This file is a CMake module script named 'CompileAidl.cmake' that defines a function 'compile_aidl' used to generate source code from AIDL files during the build process. It includes documentation comments explaining how to use the function and how it integrates into the build system.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to compile AIDL files into source code using the specified aidl compiler, with configurable options for language, include directories, target directory, and additional flags.
